title: Newton's Laws of Motion
subject: Physics
summary: Inertia, F=ma and action-reaction — the three laws with the calculations JAMB actually asks.

blocks.text: A body stays at rest, or keeps moving in a straight line at constant speed, until an external force acts on it. That reluctance to change state is **inertia**, and it depends only on mass: more mass, more inertia.

items: Passengers lurch forward when a bus brakes — their bodies keep the original motion
A dusting cloth removes dust because the cloth moves while the dust resists
Seat belts exist to supply the external force your body needs in a crash

blocks.text: Key point: no change of motion happens without an external force — "constant velocity" means the forces balance to zero.

The acceleration of a body is directly proportional to the resultant force, inversely proportional to its mass, and points in the force's direction. One **newton** is the force that gives a 1 kg mass an acceleration of 1 m/s².

items: List the forces and find the resultant
Apply F = ma to get the acceleration
Use kinematics if the question asks for velocity or distance

blocks.text: A 2 kg mass pushed with 10 N against friction of 2 N accelerates at (10 - 2) / 2 = 4 m/s². Examiners hide the second force — friction, tension or weight — so always subtract before you divide.
Key point: resultant force first, then F = ma. Never divide the raw push by the mass.

For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction — equal in size, opposite in direction, acting on **different bodies**. That last phrase is the trap: because the two forces act on different objects, they never cancel each other.

items: A gun recoils as the bullet leaves; the rocket rises by pushing gas down
Walking works because you push the ground backward and the ground pushes you forward
Swimming, rowing and jet propulsion are all third-law engines

blocks.text: Momentum is mass times velocity, and the second law can be rewritten as "force equals rate of change of momentum". In collisions where no external force acts, total momentum is **conserved** — the bookkeeping that makes crash and explosion questions solvable.

items: Before = after: m1u1 + m2u2 = m1v1 + m2v2
An explosion starts from rest, so the fragments' momenta cancel in pairs
